stories.h: JPMorgan reportedly places N50 billion with the CBN as it chases a Nigerian merchant banking licence
stories.p: The US banking giant is said to have deposited N50 billion with the Central Bank, meeting the capital requirement for a merchant bank licence. Reports stress that the deposit does not guarantee approval, which the CBN must still decide. The bank is reportedly hoping to start operations by the end of 2026 or early 2027.
more: The N50 billion minimum was raised from N15 billion under the 2024 banking reforms.
Neither the CBN nor JPMorgan had publicly commented at the time of the reports.
stories.alt: JPMorgan Chase Tower in Houston
stories.credit: Photo: Ken Lund / Flickr, CC BY-SA 2.0

stories.h: Lere Olayinka reportedly asks DSS and police to probe viral video said to threaten Christians in Jos and Enugu
stories.p: The media aide to the FCT Minister has reportedly alerted security agencies to a video that allegedly calls for violence against Christians. He wants the clip investigated and those behind it identified. The origin and authenticity of the video have not been independently verified.
more: Security agencies had not publicly responded at the time of the report.
The call comes amid heightened political tension ahead of the 2027 elections.

stories.h: David Umahi reportedly questions why Igbos should accept only four years of the presidency
stories.p: The Works Minister is said to have reacted to Peter Obi's single-term pledge, asking why the South-East should settle for four years when others have served eight. His remarks add to the debate over Obi's plan to serve one term if elected in 2027. Supporters of the pledge argue that results matter more than tenure length.
more: Obi has said he would serve a single four-year term if elected on the NDC platform.
Igbo leaders remain divided over the idea.

stories.h: Itele explains why he defended Irewole Olaniyan amid the affair scandal
stories.p: The actor says he does not want to see the woman fall and that is why he spoke up for her. He also explained why he cautioned his wife during the row. His comments have drawn mixed reactions online.
more: Itele said he acted out of concern rather than taking sides.
Fans are split over his handling of the matter.

stories.h: Trump reportedly compliments Nicki Minaj's looks at a Michigan rally, drawing mixed reactions
stories.p: A video said to be from a Michigan rally shows the US president making a remark about the rapper's appearance. Social media users have reacted with a mix of amusement and criticism. Minaj has been a vocal supporter of Trump this year.
more: Minaj called herself his "number one fan" at an event in January.
The clip has spread widely on social media.
stories.alt: Nicki Minaj
stories.credit: Photo: Eva Rinaldi Celebrity Photographer / Flickr, CC BY-SA 2.0

stories.h: Ruth Kadiri says couples do not need an expensive wedding
stories.p: The Nollywood actress has spoken about the pressure lavish ceremonies place on couples. She argues that a marriage matters more than the size of the party. Her comments come days after Zlatan Ibile's star-studded wedding dominated timelines.
more: She urged couples to spend within their means.
Reactions online have been largely supportive.
stories.alt: Two gold wedding rings
stories.credit: Stock image: firemedic58 / Flickr, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: Imagine calling the police on a 3-year-old because he is too good at football!
stories.p: Parents at a children's football practice reportedly called the police because a talented 3-year-old boy was dominating the game and barely letting the other children touch the ball. According to the circulating account, the police reportedly showed up.
body: According to a circulating account, parents at a children's football practice reportedly called the police because a talented 3-year-old boy was dominating the game and barely allowing the other children to touch the ball.
Instead of speaking to the child's parents or asking the coach to encourage him to share possession and involve his teammates, they allegedly decided to involve the police.
And the saddest part? The police reportedly showed up!
We are talking about a 3-year-old child, for goodness' sake. A little boy who is simply enjoying football and showing remarkable ability at such a young age.

At that age, children are supposed to be learning, having fun, making friends and developing their talents. If one child is dominating the game, that is an opportunity for the coach to teach teamwork and fair play.
What kind of society are we creating when adults cannot resolve a simple disagreement at children's football practice without involving law enforcement?
stories.alt: Four photos of toddlers in red and blue football kits chasing a red ball on a grass pitch
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: Chioma reportedly gushes over her sister's glamorous look at Zlatan Ibile's wedding
stories.p: Davido's wife Chioma has reportedly shared her admiration for her sister's styling at Zlatan Ibile's star-studded wedding. The event continues to dominate celebrity chatter, with guests' outfits and moments still being widely discussed online.
more: Chioma is said to have praised the look in a post shared after the ceremony.
Davido's own moments at the wedding have also drawn plenty of online reaction.

stories.h: INEC reportedly sets a timeline for deciding the fate of Pantami's and Gwarzo's governorship candidacies
stories.p: INEC has reportedly indicated when Isa Ali Pantami in Gombe and Aminu Gwarzo in Kano will learn whether their governorship bids stand. Both names were missing from the commission's final list earlier this month, and their parties have disputed the omission. Pantami has also vowed to expose those he says are plotting against his bid.
more: Both names were left off the final governorship candidates list published on 10 October.
Their parties insist the two men remain their candidates in Gombe and Kano.
The governorship and presidential elections are scheduled for 6 February 2027.

stories.h: Woli Agba and Dele Omo Woli reportedly take legal action over claims linking them to Toluwanisings' death
stories.p: Gospel singer Woli Agba and Dele Omo Woli have reportedly begun legal steps over online claims that connect them to the death of singer Toluwanisings. The late singer died on 14 October, and speculation about the circumstances has been circulating since.
more: Woli Agba had earlier urged the public not to jump to conclusions while the singer was unwell.
The singer's father has also spoken publicly about his son's death.
Fans continue to pay tribute to the late gospel artiste.

stories.h: Phyna reportedly tells Nigerian hookup girls to take their work more seriously
stories.p: Big Brother Naija star Phyna has reportedly called out some women in Nigeria's hookup scene, saying they put less effort into their appearance than their counterparts abroad. Her remarks are drawing mixed reactions online.
more: Phyna says presentation matters if the work is to be treated as a serious job.
Social media users are split, with some backing her and others calling the comments harsh.

stories.h: Brazil chooses Lula again: he beats Flávio Bolsonaro to win a fourth term
stories.p: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has won Brazil's closely fought presidential runoff, defeating Senator Flávio Bolsonaro by roughly 51.8% to 48.2% after the full count, a margin of about 4.4 million votes. The victory gives Lula a fourth presidential term and completes a remarkable comeback after Bolsonaro led the first round. The result is drawing attention around the world.
more: Bolsonaro won the first round with about 47% to Lula's 45%, making Lula the first candidate since 1989 to come from behind and win a Brazilian runoff.
Voting was extended by two hours on election day, which the Bolsonaro camp may challenge in court.
Lula, now 80, begins his new term in January 2027.
stories.alt: Side-by-side portraits of Flávio Bolsonaro, left, wearing a green and yellow sash, and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, right, in a straw hat
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: "8 out of every 10 obituaries in the Southeast are men!" Woman raises alarm at Imo funeral over pressure on Igbo men
stories.p: A woman reportedly lost her cool at a funeral in Imo State, saying eight out of every ten obituaries she sees in the Southeast are of men. Her figure has not been independently verified, but her outburst has sparked a wider conversation about the pressures many men face in silence.
body: A woman reportedly lost her cool during a funeral ceremony in Imo State as she raised serious concerns about what she believes is an alarming number of men dying prematurely across Ala Igbo.

According to her, eight out of every ten obituaries she comes across in the Southeast are those of men. Although this figure has not been independently verified, her emotional outburst has raised an important conversation about the struggles many men face in silence.
She argued that financial responsibilities, marital problems, emotional stress, family expectations and the constant pressure to provide are gradually wearing many men down.

In her view, some men are carrying burdens that nobody seems interested in discussing. They are expected to pay the bills, provide for their wives and children, support extended family members and remain strong regardless of what they are going through.
She also accused some wives of making matters worse through constant domestic conflict, excessive financial demands and a lack of emotional support.

However, it would be unfair to blame women generally for men's deaths without credible evidence. Health conditions, economic hardship, lifestyle factors and access to medical care must also be considered.
But there is a serious question here that deserves attention.

When a man is struggling financially, who checks on his mental health? When he is emotionally exhausted, who listens to him? When he can no longer meet everyone's expectations, does his family support him or make him feel like a failure?
In many homes, men are expected to be strong even when everything around them is falling apart.
Marriage should be a place of peace and mutual support, not another source of unbearable pressure for either partner.
If this woman's observation reflects a wider problem, then Igbo communities need to examine the health, welfare and life expectancy of their men more seriously.
stories.alt: A woman in a black top and checked wrapper speaks into a microphone at a funeral, with other women in matching outfits standing behind her
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: Tinubu reportedly launches his APC re-election campaign with a flag-off in Kaduna
stories.p: The APC is said to have formally opened its 2027 presidential campaign in Kaduna, with President Tinubu delivering the keynote address. The full text of his speech has been circulating online. The campaign is reportedly set to move on to Port Harcourt and Maiduguri.
more: The flag-off follows the NDC and ADC unveiling their own campaign councils.
Supporters and critics have been reacting to the speech online.
The next campaign stops are reportedly Rivers and Borno states.
stories.alt: President Bola Tinubu
stories.credit: Photo: Nosa Asemota / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

stories.h: NCDC says Nigeria has one confirmed Ebola case as contact tracing continues
stories.p: The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control says one confirmed Ebola case remains in the country, alongside two suspected cases. Dozens of contacts of the patient, who reportedly travelled from Uganda, have been identified and are being monitored. Authorities urge the public to rely on official updates.
more: A toll-free line, 6232, is open for reporting suspected cases.
Several states, including Zamfara, have stepped up airport and motor-park screening.
Contacts under monitoring are due weekly allowances, the agency has said.
stories.alt: Microscope image of Ebola virus particles
stories.credit: Stock image: National Institutes of Health (NIH) / Flickr, Public domain 1.0

stories.h: Tonto Dikeh's growing ministry draws attention as a prophecy video goes viral
stories.p: A viral video reportedly shows a prophet urging Tonto Dikeh to get a medical check-up, as her ministry draws growing attention online. The actress has not been reported to have responded, and reactions are split.
more: Fans have flooded the comments with prayers and questions.
Her recent move into ministry has kept her in the headlines.
stories.alt: Tonto Dikeh
stories.credit: Photo: KING TONTO DIKEH / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

stories.h: Content creator Genevieve urges Nigerians to stop voting along tribal lines
stories.p: Creator Genevieve has reportedly said tribal loyalty should not outweigh capability and good governance when Nigerians vote in 2027. Her comments, aimed at some supporters of the president, have drawn mixed reactions online.
more: Some users agreed, while others accused her of taking sides.
Ethnic and regional voting patterns are a major talking point ahead of 2027.

stories.h: Egungun of Lagos thanks Zlatan Ibile for the money that bought his first costume
stories.p: The performer known as the Egungun of Lagos has reportedly said Zlatan gave him money seven years ago to buy his first costume. He shared the message around the rapper's wedding, and fans praised the gesture.
more: Zlatan's traditional wedding has dominated entertainment chatter this weekend.
Many fans say the story shows the rapper's generosity.

stories.h: Qatar reportedly sets four conditions for foreigners seeking a company-sponsored work visa
stories.p: Qatar has reportedly announced four requirements that foreigners must meet to obtain a company-sponsored work visa. The details are drawing attention from Nigerians interested in working in the Gulf.
more: Gulf work visas remain a popular topic among young Nigerians.
stories.alt: Doha skyline at night
stories.credit: Stock image: jikatu / Flickr, CC BY-SA 2.0

stories.h: Daniel Bwala reportedly responds to the NDC's 2027 campaign council list
stories.p: Presidential aide Daniel Bwala has reportedly reacted to the NDC's newly released campaign council, which features Peter Obi, Rabiu Kwankwaso and Governor Dickson. Details of his remarks were still emerging.
more: The NDC named the council earlier on Sunday.
The APC flagged off its own presidential campaign over the weekend.

stories.h: Davido and Small Doctor's interaction at Zlatan's wedding sparks online chatter
stories.p: A moment between Davido and Small Doctor at Zlatan Ibile's wedding has reportedly drawn plenty of reaction online, with fans debating what it meant.
more: The wedding has produced a string of viral moments involving Davido.
Guests included many music and Nollywood stars.

stories.h: NDC reportedly drops its Borno House of Assembly candidate
stories.p: The Nigeria Democratic Congress has reportedly removed its candidate for a House of Assembly seat in Borno State. The move is said to come as the party unveils its 2027 campaign council. No further details on the reason were immediately available.
more: The party has not been widely quoted on the decision.
It follows other disputes over candidate lists in several states.

stories.h: Fox News presenters Sean Hannity and Ainsley Earhardt reportedly marry in Florida
stories.p: Fox News presenters Sean Hannity and Ainsley Earhardt have reportedly married in Florida after a pre-wedding party said to have been attended by Donald Trump. The couple announced their engagement in late 2024.
more: The pre-wedding party was reportedly attended by the US president.
The two have long been among Fox News's best-known faces.
stories.alt: Sean Hannity speaking at an event
stories.credit: Photo: Gage Skidmore / Flickr, CC BY-SA 2.0

stories.h: Kylian Mbappe reportedly scores twice in El Clasico, shaking up Ballon d'Or talk
stories.p: Kylian Mbappe has reportedly scored two goals in El Clasico, prompting fresh updates to the Ballon d'Or rankings. Fans and pundits are debating where the goals leave him in this year's race. Ballon d'Or rankings have since been updated to reflect his form.
more: Ballon d'Or rankings have reportedly been reshuffled after the match.
Fans are debating his place in this year's race.
stories.alt: Kylian Mbappé playing for France
stories.credit: Photo: Кирилл Венедиктов / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0

stories.h: Hurzeler reportedly denies interest in the Manchester United head coach job
stories.p: Brighton boss Fabian Hurzeler has reportedly dismissed talk linking him with the Manchester United job. Reports say he is focused on his current club, while speculation continues over who could succeed Michael Carrick.
more: Several other managers are being tipped online as possible replacements.
United have not commented on the speculation.

stories.h: Rita Edochie clarifies her stance on polygamy
stories.p: Nollywood actress Rita Edochie has reportedly explained that she is not against polygamy, in comments that have drawn mixed reactions online.
more: Her remarks have been widely shared on social media.
Fans are divided over her explanation.

stories.h: Zookeeper in coma after reported leopard attack at Dutch safari park
stories.p: A zookeeper at Safaripark Beekse Bergen in the Netherlands is reportedly in a critical condition and sedated after being attacked by a leopard. The park is said to be investigating how the incident happened.
more: Emergency services were reportedly called to the scene.
The park has not given further details on the keeper's condition.

stories.h: Lady shocked at how hot solar panels on a neighbouring building became under the sun
stories.p: A lady has gone viral after showing how hot the solar panels on a three-storey building next to her house had become under the scorching sun, saying she never imagined they could generate that much heat. Solar panels can get extremely hot in direct sunlight, with surface temperatures sometimes reaching 60°C to 80°C or more in very hot weather. They are designed to turn sunlight into electricity, but they also absorb heat, and too much heat can actually reduce how well they work.
more: A panel feeling very hot does not mean it is faulty or about to catch fire; smoke, flames, a burning smell or visible damage would be the warning signs.
More Nigerians are installing rooftop solar because of the electricity situation.
But how many people really understand how these systems work?
stories.alt: Sunlight glares off solar panels on the dark roof of a cream three-storey building, seen from a neighbouring rooftop
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: APC youth leaders receive Toyota Prado SUVs for election mobilisation
stories.p: APC National Youth Leader Dayo Israel has shared a video saying he presented Toyota Prado SUVs to selected youth leaders to support the party's election mobilisation. At least seven vehicles appear in the footage, some branded with the APC logo. Israel also thanked First Lady Oluremi Tinubu for her continuing support.
more: The handover comes as parties step up campaigning ahead of the 2027 elections.
It follows earlier debate online over branded SUVs being used for the 2027 campaign.
The party has not said how many youth leaders will receive vehicles in total.
stories.alt: Black Toyota Prado SUVs, one branded "All Progressives Congress, Government House Abuja", parked on a street in Abuja
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: NDC reportedly unveils its 2027 campaign council with Peter Obi, Kwankwaso and Dickson
stories.p: The Nigeria Democratic Congress has reportedly named its campaign council for the 2027 elections. The list is said to include presidential candidate Peter Obi, his running mate Rabiu Kwankwaso and party leader Seriake Dickson.
more: The announcement follows weeks of meetings in Abuja over the council's make-up.
The party had earlier dismissed reports of division over the Obi-Kwankwaso ticket.
stories.alt: Peter Obi
stories.credit: Photo: Plus TV Africa / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 3.0

stories.h: Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala announces the death of her mother, Prof Kamene Okonjo, aged 96
stories.p: WTO Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala has announced that her mother, Professor Kamene Okonjo, has died at the age of 96. Tributes are expected from across Nigeria and beyond.
more: Prof Okonjo was a respected academic and a former traditional title holder in Delta State.
The family is expected to announce funeral arrangements.
stories.alt: Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala speaking at a conference
stories.credit: Photo: Perambara/Amantha Perera / Flickr, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: Zamfara steps up Ebola screening after a traveller reportedly arrives with a fever
stories.p: The Zamfara State government has reportedly activated Ebola surveillance at Gusau airport and major motor parks. This follows the arrival of a passenger from Saudi Arabia said to have had a 38-degree fever.
more: Health officials have urged residents to report anyone with symptoms.
It comes as the NCDC approves weekly payments for people placed under monitoring.

stories.h: NFL and players' union reportedly review Jalen Hurts' blood clot diagnosis
stories.p: The NFL and the NFL Players Association are reportedly jointly investigating the medical care given to Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts after a blood clot diagnosis.
more: The review is said to focus on how the condition was identified and treated.
There is no official word yet on when he could return to play.
stories.alt: Jalen Hurts
stories.credit: Photo: All-Pro Reels / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.0

stories.h: UK Defence Secretary says Britain must be ready for war within 1,000 days
stories.p: The UK Defence Secretary has said Britain must strengthen its military readiness because potential adversaries could be able to attack by around 2030.
more: The warning is aimed at pushing faster investment in the armed forces.
Opposition parties are expected to press for details on funding.

stories.h: Soludo reportedly rules out automatic Anambra backing for Peter Obi in 2027
stories.p: Anambra Governor Charles Soludo has reportedly said the state will not back Peter Obi by default in the 2027 presidential race. He is said to have argued that the 2027 contest will not be a repeat of 2023.
more: The remark adds to the debate over how Obi will fare in his home region.
Obi supporters have previously said he does not need any coalition to win.

stories.h: Labour body reportedly warned of risks ahead of new minimum wage demand
stories.p: A fresh warning has reportedly been issued to the Nigeria Labour Congress over possible consequences if its new minimum wage demand is approved. Details of the demand and the response from government were still being discussed.
more: Workers have long pressed for pay to keep pace with prices.
Government and employers are yet to agree a new figure.

stories.h: Spanish media reportedly criticise Lookman after another early substitution at Atletico Madrid
stories.p: Ademola Lookman was reportedly taken off in the first half for the third time in four La Liga games, drawing criticism from the Spanish press. The Nigeria forward is said to be struggling to hold down a regular role.
more: Fans in Nigeria are watching his form closely.
Atletico have not publicly explained the changes.

stories.h: Victor Osimhen's record against Fenerbahce in focus ahead of Istanbul derby
stories.p: Attention is turning to Victor Osimhen's past results against Fenerbahce ahead of the Istanbul derby. The Nigeria striker is expected to be central to his side's hopes in the big match.
more: Turkish fans are expecting a tense, high-scoring night.
Nigerian supporters will be tuning in to watch him.

stories.h: Atiku criticises reports of security agents guarding Tinubu campaign banners in Kaduna
stories.p: Atiku Abubakar has reportedly criticised claims that security personnel were stationed to protect APC campaign banners in Kaduna. The former vice-president, now a leading opposition figure, said public security resources should not be used for party materials. There has been no official response from the APC or the security agencies in the reports seen so far.
more: Campaign banners have become a flashpoint as parties step up activity ahead of 2027.
The APC has not commented in the reports seen so far.

stories.h: Kwankwaso says Tinubu does not deserve a second term
stories.p: Rabiu Kwankwaso has reportedly said President Tinubu has not earned a second term in office. He pointed to the cost of living and the state of the economy as reasons. Supporters of the president have defended his reforms as necessary for long-term growth.
more: Kwankwaso is part of the opposition NDC platform alongside Peter Obi.
The APC says the economy is stabilising under the reforms.

stories.h: Pantami says he will expose those allegedly plotting against his Gombe governorship bid
stories.p: Former minister Isa Ali Pantami has reportedly said he will name those he alleges are working against his bid to become governor of Gombe State. He did not give details in the reports seen so far. Those he appears to refer to have not responded publicly.
more: The Gombe race is already drawing attention ahead of 2027.
No names have been confirmed in reports so far.

stories.h: Macron reportedly postpones planned 28 October visit to Nigeria
stories.p: French President Emmanuel Macron has reportedly delayed his planned trip to Nigeria, which was due on 28 October. No new date has been given in the reports seen so far. The visit had been expected to focus on trade and security ties.
more: No reason for the delay has been confirmed in the reports seen so far.
A new date has not been announced.

stories.h: Kano Hisbah reportedly detains TikToker and two other women over dance videos
stories.p: The Kano State Hisbah board has reportedly detained a TikToker, Amani Ishaq, and two other women over dance videos it considers immoral. The agency enforces Islamic moral rules in the state. It has not said what will happen next, according to the reports seen so far.
more: Hisbah has made similar arrests of content creators in the past.
Reaction on social media has been mixed.

stories.h: Former BBNaija housemate Mike Edwards surprised by DNA ancestry result
stories.p: Former Big Brother Naija housemate Mike Edwards has reportedly shared a DNA test that shows his ancestry is mainly Igbo and Yoruba. He said he was surprised by the result. The post has drawn reactions from fans online.
more: DNA ancestry tests have become a popular trend among Nigerian celebrities.
Fans have been sharing their own results in reply.

stories.h: Arsenal winger Bukayo Saka reportedly out for up to eight weeks with injury
stories.p: Arsenal winger Bukayo Saka is reportedly facing up to eight weeks on the sidelines with an injury. The club is said to be assessing the best treatment plan. The news is a blow to Arsenal in the Premier League title race.
more: Arsenal have not given a firm return date in the reports seen so far.
He could miss a busy run of league and European games.

stories.h: Cristiano Ronaldo reportedly scores his 982nd career goal
stories.p: Cristiano Ronaldo has reportedly scored again, taking his career tally to 982 goals. He continues to add to a record that no other player is close to matching. Fans are discussing how near he is to the 1,000 mark.
more: The 1,000-goal milestone is his stated target.
Reaction online has been strong among both fans and critics.

stories.h: Manchester United goalkeeper Andre Onana reportedly escapes serious injury in car crash in Turkey
stories.p: Goalkeeper Andre Onana has reportedly been involved in a car crash in Turkey and escaped without serious injury. Details of the incident are limited in the reports seen so far. No official statement from his club has been seen yet.
more: He is said to be safe and well.
The cause of the crash has not been confirmed.

stories.h: US Justice Department reportedly charges two former FBI officials over testimony on Hunter Biden laptop
stories.p: The US Justice Department has reportedly charged two former FBI officials in connection with their testimony about the Hunter Biden laptop. Details of the charges have not been fully set out in the reports seen so far. Lawyers for the two have not been quoted.
more: The laptop story has been a political flashpoint in the US for years.
The two are presumed innocent unless proven otherwise.

stories.h: Analyst says Governor Makinde's 2027 presidential bid is a test of the waters, not a serious bid to win
stories.p: A political analyst has reportedly described Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde's move towards the 2027 presidential race as exploratory. The analyst said it appears aimed at gauging support rather than a determined push to win. Makinde's camp has not been quoted in the report.
more: The 2027 field is already crowded, with APC, ADC and NDC camps all making their pitch.
Analysts say the North-West and South-West could decide the race.

stories.h: Mother and child reportedly die as two container trucks overturn in Lagos
stories.p: A mother and her child have reportedly died after two container trucks overturned at Mile 2 in Apapa, Lagos. Emergency responders are said to have been called to the scene. The cause of the accident has not been confirmed.
more: Heavy container traffic around the Apapa corridor has long been a safety concern.
Further details from the authorities are awaited.
stories.alt: Container trucks on a highway
stories.credit: Stock image: futureatlas.com / Flickr, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: Woman says friends were killed in Edo even after N25 million ransom was paid for each of them
stories.p: A woman has reportedly cried out online over the deaths of friends in Edo State, saying a ransom of N25 million was paid for each of them before they were killed. The claim has not been independently confirmed. It has renewed debate about kidnapping and insecurity in the state.
more: Nigerians online are calling on security agencies to act.
The police have not yet responded to the claim.

stories.h: Baby in Ecuador reportedly born with a full moustache
stories.p: A newborn baby in Ecuador has gone viral after reportedly arriving with what looks like a full moustache. While most newborns are still struggling to open their eyes, this little one allegedly came out looking like he already has a wife, three children and bills to pay. Photos of the baby, wrapped in a towel with dark hair above his lip, have been shared widely online.
more: Social media users have been flooding the photos with jokes about the baby's "grown man" look.
Some newborns are born with extra fine body hair, which usually falls off within the first weeks of life.
The details of the birth have not been independently confirmed.
stories.alt: A newborn baby with curly wet hair and dark hair above his upper lip, wrapped in a white towel
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: Lagos reportedly plans 30-minute driver's licences and 10-minute renewals from 2027
stories.p: The Lagos State government is said to be working on a much faster driver's licence process that would start in 2027. New licences would reportedly be issued in about 30 minutes, while renewals would take around 10. No further details on cost or locations have been given yet.
more: The state has been talking about issuing its own licences in partnership with the federal government.
Drivers currently often wait weeks or months for a card.

stories.h: Fulani leaders reportedly present three demands to Tinubu on the N30 trillion livestock sector
stories.p: Fulani leaders have reportedly set out three requests to President Tinubu about Nigeria's livestock sector, which is said to be worth about N30 trillion. The group wants the sector given more attention and support from government.
more: The sector supports millions of herders and traders across the country.
The presidency has not yet been reported to have responded.

stories.h: NCDC approves N100,000 weekly payments for people under Ebola monitoring
stories.p: The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control has reportedly approved a weekly stipend of N100,000 for people being monitored as contacts of the confirmed Ebola case. The payment is said to be meant to help them stay at home for the monitoring period.
more: Health officials are still tracing contacts of the confirmed case in Abuja.
Neighbouring countries have tightened travel rules as the outbreak is watched.
stories.alt: Medics at work in an Ebola observation ward
stories.credit: Stock image: DFID - UK Department for International Development / Flickr, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: Naira weakens against the dollar even though reserves stand at about $55 billion
stories.p: A fresh CBN dollar rate shows the naira losing ground, reportedly despite foreign reserves of around $55 billion. The slide is drawing questions from traders and ordinary Nigerians.
more: Analysts say demand for dollars is still high.
Petrol and diesel prices are also being watched closely.

stories.h: Police arrest a tiler over the death of a hotel worker in Abuja
stories.p: Police in Abuja have arrested a tiler in connection with the death of a hotel staff member in the Utako area after a violent confrontation. The suspect reportedly told officers the man fell and hit his head.
more: Investigators are said to be looking into what led to the clash.
The police have not yet announced when the suspect will be charged.

stories.h: First Lady Remi Tinubu says she wants to leave Aso Rock in 2031
stories.p: Nigeria's First Lady Remi Tinubu has reportedly said she hopes to leave the presidential villa in 2031 for a Nigeria she can enjoy. The remark, made as the 2027 campaign gets under way, is drawing mixed reactions online.
more: Supporters read it as confidence in a second term for her husband.
Opposition voices say Nigerians want results, not predictions.

stories.h: NDLEA arrests a South African woman and a Nigerian-American grandmother at Lagos airport
stories.p: The anti-narcotics agency has reportedly detained two travellers at the Lagos airport, one of them a South African woman said to have been carrying about 36 kilograms of cocaine. The second is a Nigerian-American grandmother. Further details on the second case were not immediately available.
more: The South African woman was reportedly found with 36.65kg of the drug.
The agency has not said when the suspects will be charged.
stories.alt: Suitcases lined up in an airport baggage hall (stock image)
stories.credit: Stock image: Chor Ip / Flickr, CC BY-SA 2.0

stories.h: Tacha tells Big Brother Naija organisers what they must do to win viewers back
stories.p: Former housemate Tacha has reportedly given the organisers of Big Brother Naija her advice on how to win back viewers. Her comments are said to have sparked a conversation among fans of the reality show.
more: Fans have been sharing their own views on the show online.
stories.alt: A television remote control (stock image)
stories.credit: Stock image: Dmitry Makeev / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

stories.h: What really happened between Bella Shmurda and Davido? Wedding moment raises eyebrows
stories.p: A moment involving singers Bella Shmurda and Davido at Zlatan Ibile's traditional wedding has sparked reactions on social media. In a clip now circulating online, Bella Shmurda approaches the area where Davido is seated but appears to reach past him to shake hands with the person sitting right next to him. Given how close the two were, some viewers believe it would have been hard for Bella not to notice Davido, and that is what has people talking.
more: Some fans are asking whether it was a deliberate snub.
Others wonder if something is going on between the two artists that the public does not know about.
Or are Nigerians simply reading too much into an ordinary moment? Neither singer has commented.
stories.alt: Guests in traditional attire shake hands at Zlatan Ibile's wedding
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: Eniola Badmus and Davido at Zlatan Ibile's wedding: a reunion that has fans talking
stories.p: Nollywood actress Eniola Badmus and Afrobeats star Davido have caught the attention of social media users after both appeared at Zlatan Ibile's lavish wedding celebration. The two were once known as close friends, with Eniola openly cheering the singer on through different stages of his career. Their relationship was reported to have cooled after the death of Davido's son, Ifeanyi, in 2022, when the actress faced heavy criticism online over posts about the tragedy. Neither of them has said whether their differences have been settled, so attending the same wedding may not mean the friendship is back.
more: Friendships in the entertainment industry can cool through misunderstandings or public pressure, and sometimes recover quietly away from the cameras.
Zlatan's wedding brought together some of the biggest names in Nigerian entertainment, and fans are following every moment.
Would you like to see Davido and Eniola Badmus rebuild their old friendship, or are some friendships better left in the past?
stories.alt: Davido, in a red cap, smiles as he hugs a guest in a gele at Zlatan Ibile's wedding
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: Dangote Cement reportedly lines up a $1bn London share sale as the boss visits the stock exchange
stories.p: Dangote Cement is reportedly preparing to sell about 10 per cent of the company to investors in London, a deal that could raise around $1 billion as early as November. The sale is said to involve existing shareholders rather than new shares, with Goldman Sachs and UBS reportedly arranging it. Aliko Dangote was reported to have visited the London Stock Exchange as investor meetings were expected to begin from 27 October.
more: Investor sessions are reportedly planned for London, South Africa and Dubai.
The timing is said to depend on market conditions.
stories.alt: Aliko Dangote
stories.credit: Photo: World Economic Forum / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.0

stories.h: Natasha Osawaru shares a video of Peter Obi, drawing reactions ahead of 2027
stories.p: Edo lawmaker and 2Baba's wife Natasha Osawaru reportedly posted a video of Peter Obi, the NDC presidential candidate, and it has drawn mixed reactions online. She earlier backed Obi and Rabiu Kwankwaso at the NDC convention and has since won the party's ticket for her state assembly seat.
more: She is set to contest the Egor seat in 2027.
Supporters of other parties have also joined the online debate.
stories.alt: Peter Obi
stories.credit: Photo: VOA / Wikimedia Commons, Public domain

stories.h: Gunmen kill at least 10 people in eastern Nigeria, police confirm
stories.p: Gunmen have killed at least 10 people in an attack in eastern Nigeria, police have confirmed. The killings have renewed serious concern about the worsening security situation in parts of the country, where communities continue to face threats from armed attackers. Behind the death toll are grieving families whose lives have been changed forever.
more: Many Nigerians are asking how long lives will continue to be lost to gun violence.
Protecting lives and property remains one of the government's most important duties.
Nigerians say they deserve to live, work and travel without constant fear for their safety.
stories.alt: Armed police officers in helmets and vests line a street in a Nigerian town
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: Jay-Z praises daughter Blue Ivy after she joins him on stage on piano
stories.p: Jay-Z reportedly bowed to his 14-year-old daughter, Blue Ivy, and hyped her up when she joined him on stage and performed on the piano. Clips of the moment are said to be circulating widely online.
more: Blue Ivy has increasingly appeared on stage with her parents in recent years.
Fans online praised the father-daughter moment.
stories.alt: Jay-Z at a Shawn Carter Foundation event
stories.credit: Photo: Joella Marano from Manhattan, NY / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0

stories.h: Report says insecurity is worsening in Nigeria even as a stability index shows rising economic confidence
stories.p: A new report reportedly shows insecurity getting worse across Nigeria, while a separate stability index points to improving economic confidence. The mixed picture is drawing attention as the 2027 campaign season gets under way.
more: The report is said to highlight kidnappings and attacks in several states.
Analysts say economic confidence and security perceptions do not always move together.
stories.alt: Nigeria supporters in green and white hold up the national flag (stock image)
stories.credit: Stock image: manbeastextraordinaire / Flickr, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: Nigeria Customs shares an update on its recruitment exercise
stories.p: The Nigeria Customs Service has reportedly issued fresh details on its recruitment exercise, which it says is moving to an annual cycle. Candidates are advised to rely only on the service's official channels for information.
more: The previous exercise reportedly selected 3,852 candidates from more than 573,000 applicants.
Successful candidates have been told to watch their registered email and SMS for instructions.
stories.alt: Stacks of shipping containers at a port (stock image)
stories.credit: Stock image: Unknown / Rawpixel, CC0 1.0

stories.h: Brother and sister both graduate with first-class degrees from UNILORIN
stories.p: A brother and sister have both reportedly earned first-class degrees from the University of Ilorin, in different departments and with different CGPAs. Their achievement is being celebrated online.
more: The University of Ilorin has had several widely shared first-class stories this week.
Congratulations poured in from netizens.
stories.alt: Graduates' mortarboard caps at a ceremony (stock image)
stories.credit: Stock image: j.o.h.n. walker / Flickr, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: Davido's reaction as a DJ plays a Wizkid song at Zlatan Ibile's wedding gets fans talking
stories.p: A DJ reportedly played a Wizkid track at Zlatan Ibile's wedding, and Davido's reaction in the moment has been shared widely. Fans are debating what his expression meant.
more: Clips of the moment are circulating on social media.
Fans of both singers have joined the debate.
stories.alt: Davido performing on stage in Lagos
stories.credit: Photo: Kaizenify / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0
